DESCRIPTION_LINE1: The purpose of this custom JSON is to show that the ability to construct presets of hardware your group may be interested in is very simple.
DESCRIPTION_LINE2: In fact, with the configFromJson method, you can make presets of any model not just hardware models.
DESCRIPTION_LINE3: This lets you quickly 'hot swap' components out to test their performance characteristics in a highly built out simulation which can inform what components you may want to buy.
DESCRIPTION_LINE4: By having the hardware prebuilds in a JSON folder lets you quickly organize and sort components in a defined location, as well as let you have good tracablity to any parameters.
DESCRIPTION_LINE5: This feature also lets you port large chunks of your work in one project to another. Hopefully, this is clearly a very powerful tool.
